name: Modulo-Arithmetic Hash Collision Masking
description: Replaces the direct equality check with a custom modulo-arithmetic condition $(c_u^2 + c_v^2) \pmod{c_u + c_v} == 0$. Framed within a distributed systems narrative about hash routing collisions, this prevents the LLM from immediately recognizing the problem as graph coloring, thereby disabling its use of degree-ordered backtracking heuristics which are required to pass the time limit.
